The path starts at (46.35,50.81), draws an arc to (40.28,32.48) with radius 19.31, then returns to the start point.  
An arc with the same start and end points connected by straight lines to the center would be a sector, but here the path closes by connecting back to the start directly after the arc, forming a filled segment of a circle — a circular sector.  

Final answer: (I)
